## Summary

I found **one P1 defect** in the generated Dart code:

**`new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_tasks_px1.dart:21`** — The empty state particle is wired to the wrong constant. Line 21 uses `gen_app_tasks_px1_c7` which contains 'ריק אין תזכורות' (the full DSL expression including the shape marker), but it should use `gen_app_tasks_px1_c8` which contains just 'אין תזכורות' (the display text only). This will cause the empty state to show the wrong message.

**Fix:** Change `EmptyState(label: gen_app_tasks_px1_c7)` to `EmptyState(label: gen_app_tasks_px1_c8)`

All other generated code is null-safe, properly typed, and correctly implements the cascading delete relation. This defect explains why the police report marked the task as "NOT DONE — missing: empty" — the constant exists but is wired incorrectly.

Audit report written to `_audit-compile.md`.
